GET /program_signups:
# GET /program_signups

List program signups

## Base URLs

- Local: `http://api.community-management.test/api`
- Staging: `https://api.communitymanagement.xyz/api`
- Prod: `https://api.getcommunal.com/api`

## Parameters

- `filter[program_id]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity ID. Supports comma-separated values for multiple registration opportunities.
- `filter[program[parent_program_id]]` (query) - Filter by program ID. Returns signups for all registration opportunities under this program.
- `filter[user_id]` (query) - Filter by user ID. Non-managers can only filter to their own ID.
- `filter[query]` (query) - Search by registration opportunity name, user name, user email, guest name, additional member name, or guest email.
- `filter[status]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity time status. Supports multiple comma-separated values. Options: ongoing, upcoming, past.
- `filter[signup_status]` (query) - Manager-only signup lifecycle filter. Options: active, cancelled, cancelled:member, cancelled:admin. Defaults to active.
- `filter[timeScope]` (query) - Simple time scope filter. Options: upcoming (includes ongoing and active), past, all.
- `filter[event_start_date]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity event date range. Pass as array: filter[event_start_date][0]=start&filter[event_start_date][1]=end. Includes ongoing registration opportunities.
- `filter[upcoming]` (query) - Filter to signups for upcoming registration opportunities only.
- `filter[past]` (query) - Filter to signups for past registration opportunities only.
- `filter[ongoing]` (query) - Filter to signups for ongoing registration opportunities only.
- `filter[withTrashed]` (query) - Include soft-deleted signups. Defaults to excluding deleted.
- `filter[program[archived_at]]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity archived status. Pass empty string to exclude archived registration opportunities.
- `filter[program[deleted_at]]` (query) - Filter by registration opportunity deleted status. Pass empty string to exclude deleted registration opportunities.
- `include` (query) - Include related resources (comma-separated). Options: additionalMember, additionalMember.emergency, files, guest, program, program.parentProgram, transaction, user, user.family, user.family.emergency, formSubmissions, subscriptionSchedule.config.configurable, subscriptionSchedule.paymentsReceived, attendanceRecords.
- `X-Api-Version` (header) - Optional API version for this request. When omitted, the server uses the default version. This documentation describes version 2026-03-25.

## Responses

- `200`: Paginated set of `ProgramSignupResource`
- `401`:
